statement: There is a choice of the exponents in (P1) and a constant c > 0 with the following property. For every sufficiently small fixed ε > 0, every fixed q > 0, and s = qx1+ε, the following bounds hold for every sufficiently large fixed stencil order: 1. On each direct segment, Z Eγ h 1{Km(s)≤3xε}|ψ̇m(s)| i |dϑ| ≲ x5+c , uniformly for N/2 ≤ m ≤ 3N, where ϑ is that segment’s parameter. 2. On the size segment the corresponding bound holds for ψ̇m(s) + r X j=0 cj(m + j)ψm+j(s) . (I) It also holds when m is a measurable function of θ with values in this integer range, or when the observables are averaged with nonnegative probability weights on these integers depending measurably on θ. All integrations use absolute path-parameter length. The saving c can be chosen independently of sufficiently small ε. Constants may depend on the fixed test coefficient q, stencil order, and the fixed temperature.
